activities.title: Casa Vostra — viral Italian finally lands in Tampines
activities.description: The Raffles City Italian hit from chef Antonio Miscellaneo opened its third outlet at Tampines Mall on 15 May 2026. Everything is made from scratch and nothing on the menu tops S$30 — the crab tagliatelle (S$26) and margherita (S$17) are the signatures. The Tampines outlet gets six exclusive dishes, including a smoked-provola margherita affumicata (S$19) and seabass-stuffed agnolotti with Argentinean prawns (S$27).
activities.why: Six Tampines-exclusive dishes you can't get at the town outlets — easties skip the Raffles City queues.
activities.parking: Tampines Mall multi-storey carpark; Tampines MRT is right outside.

activities.title: Im Qalb — brand-new Thai-Malay kitchen in Tampines
activities.description: Opened 2 Sep 2026 on Tampines Mall's fourth floor, Im Qalb is the Thai-Malay offshoot of Vincent Pang's Im Jai, run by the ex-hedge-fund chef who trained at Le Cordon Bleu Dusit in Bangkok. The menu leans into southern Thai cooking with Malay influences: golden crab tahu kai jeow (S$18.80), stir-fried squid in black ink sauce (S$19.80), and southern Thai-style ayam perchik skewers (S$18.80). It's working towards halal certification.
activities.why: Opened 2 Sep 2026 — one of the freshest openings in the heartlands this week.
activities.parking: Tampines Mall multi-storey carpark; Tampines MRT is right outside.

activities.title: Heartland by Enjoy — retro Nanyang supper till 2am
activities.description: Chef Joel Ong's third concept is a retro-styled cafe in a Tampines HDB block serving elevated Nanyang comfort food. The draw is the nasi lemak sets — pork belly berempah (S$14.90) or fried chicken berempah (S$12.90) with a choice of coconut rice or Indomie, the meats marinated over two days. Kaya butter toast (S$2.90) and Heartland laksa (S$14.90) round out the menu. It stays open until 2am daily, a rarity for supper in the east.
activities.why: A genuine late-night option in the heartlands — kitchens open till 2am every day.
activities.parking: HDB carpark at Block 481; limited at peak hours, so public transport is easier.

activities.title: Burma Social — bottomless brunch in Siglap
activities.description: Burma Social's Siglap outlet blends Burmese, Thai, Indian, Chinese and Laotian flavours in a contemporary shophouse setting. On weekends, order any main (S$28 for one, S$38 for two) and unlock 90 minutes of unlimited momos and samosas — the signature Burmese noodles and mala veg wok are the mains to beat. A boozy upgrade (S$49) adds two hours of free-flow Asahi, prosecco, wine and spirits.
activities.why: The weekend bottomless brunch (free-flow momos and samosas) is the best-value leisurely lunch on the East Coast.
activities.when: Wed-Sun 11:30am-3pm; dinner Tue-Sun 6pm-11pm (Fri-Sat till 12am); closed Mon
activities.parking: Limited street parking on East Coast Road; buses 13/16 or Marine Terrace MRT plus a short bus ride.

activities.title: Punggol Coast Hawker Centre — 40 stalls, Michelin names
activities.description: Singapore's newest hawker centre opened 25 Jul 2025 in Punggol Digital District with 40 stalls and 576 seats, run cashless with AI-assisted queue management. The lineup mixes heritage and hype: Michelin Bib Gourmand Singapore Fried Hokkien Mee, the revived 50-year-old South Buona Vista Braised Duck, Hock Hai (Hong Lim) Curry Chicken, plus Gen-Z stalls like What The Puff! curry puffs (from S$2). Kopi-O and teh-O go for S$1.
activities.why: The northeast's flagship new food centre — heritage stalls and young hawkers under one roof, most dishes under S$10.
activities.parking: Carpark at the hawker centre / Punggol Coast Mall; steps from Punggol Coast MRT (NEL).

activities.title: Sushidan — $19.90 omakase at Parkway Parade
activities.description: Michelin-starred-pedigree Sushidan opened its second Singapore outlet at Parkway Parade on 5 Sep 2026, bringing chef Hiroyuki Sato's Toyosu Market-sourced seafood to the East. The Goshoku Set (S$19.90++) is an entry-level omakase with chawanmushi, three mini dons and a sushi platter — remarkable value.
activities.why: Opened 5 Sep — east-coast omakase from S$19.90++ at Parkway Parade.
activities.parking: Parkway Parade carpark; Marine Parade MRT (TEL) is the nearest, or buses along Marine Parade Road.

travel.geoQuery: 80 Marine Parade Road, Parkway Parade, Singapore 449269

activities.title: Jin Le Claypot Rice — north heartland claypot institution
activities.description: A northern claypot name regulars swear by: claypot chicken rice (S$6 nett) with a generous slab of salted fish, and the gongbao frog leg (S$14 nett) in a punchy oyster-sauce gravy with chilli padi heat. Burpple reviewers call the sauce 'much much better than most' and note one pot comfortably feeds two. 4.3 stars across 140+ Google reviews.
activities.why: Gongbao frog leg and claypot rice in the northern heartlands — a Near Home food-tab spotlight.
activities.parking: HDB carpark at Blk 111; a short walk from the nearest northern MRT.

activities.title: Ivan's Carbina — Swiss rösti in a north kopitiam
activities.description: A northern original for over a decade: a humble kopitiam stall doing crisp Swiss-style rösti — crackly golden crust, soft buttery middle — paired with chicken chop (S$7.80), snail pork sausage (S$11) or a carbonara (S$5.50). Sour cream with a lemon lift comes on the side. Eatbook's verdict: decent Western food for cheap prices, worth the trip if you're in the neighbourhood. 4.2 stars from 600+ Google reviews.
activities.why: Crisp rösti at kopitiam prices — a north heartland institution for more than ten years.
activities.parking: Street parking near Lucky Star Coffeeshop; about 6 min on foot from the nearest northern MRT.

travel.geoQuery: 354A North Avenue 5, Lucky Star Coffeeshop, Singapore 730354

activities.title: Yan Ji Seafood Soup — 40 years of rich broth in Marsiling
activities.description: A 40-year-old family brand at Marsiling Mall Hawker Centre: broth slow-cooked up to six hours with old hen, pork ribs, Chinese ham and Japanese scallops. The Straits Times singled out the minced pork — pounded with toasted dried sole fish for deep umami. Bowls from S$7.50 (dory) to S$18 (crayfish); braised pig trotters (S$7) for the adventurous.
activities.why: A 40-year-old seafood soup institution — the dried-sole minced pork is the order.
activities.parking: Marsiling Mall hawker centre; Marsiling MRT is minutes away on foot.

travel.geoQuery: 4 North Street 12, Marsiling Mall Hawker Centre, Singapore 738623

activities.title: R&B Cai Fan — $7 all-you-can-pile buffet cai fan
activities.description: An ex-offender's feel-good economy rice stall in the north where you pile over 20 dishes onto one plate for a flat S$7 — no refills, but no limits on what or how much you take. Dishes rotate with fresh options like chilli crab and Peranakan specials, plus a salmon dish that sold out on debut. Run by two veteran chefs who keep prices low through supplier relationships.
activities.why: New Jun 2026 opening; unbeatable value lunch in the north
activities.parking: Public parking around the northern Ave 12 industrial estate

activities.title: Wild Honey Pie — weekend-only sourdough bakery
activities.description: The weekend alter-ego of hawker bakery Cat in the Hat, where self-taught baker Jesper Chan bakes naturally-leavened breads fermented with fruit yeast waters. Standouts include the Apple Yeast Water Rye Shokupan ($6), Red Wine Baguette with cranberry, walnut and cream cheese ($4), and a Sourdough Ebi Katsu Sando ($5). It routinely sells out — go early, because when the trays are empty by 3pm, that's it till next weekend.
activities.why: Weekend-only concept — only chance to go this week is Sat-Sun
activities.parking: The Promenade @ Pelikat basement carpark

activities.title: Wingstop — bigger Jurong Point comeback
activities.description: The Texas wing chain has returned to Jurong Point with a larger dine-in space decked out in its signature emerald green, graphic banners and neon lights. Order the classics — boneless wings from $11.30 for six, classic wings from $11.80 — in any of 12 seasonings, or try the two Jurong-exclusive sides: hand-cut onion rings ($6.45) and Cajun fried corn ($6.45).
activities.why: Reopened bigger in May 2026 with Jurong-exclusive sides
activities.parking: Jurong Point carparks (JP1/JP2), ~3 min walk

travel.geoQuery: 1 Jurong West Central 2, Jurong Point JP1, Singapore 648886

activities.title: Yishun Park Hawker Centre — new operator, fresh buzz
activities.description: Yishun's park-facing hawker centre changed hands on 20 Jul 2026, with Canopy Hawkers Group (which also runs Canberra Hawker Centre) taking over management and promising fresh ideas and a more vibrant experience. Expect the usual north-side favourites alongside new stalls, plus budget-friendly options across the board. Open daily 6am-10pm, so it covers breakfast through supper.
activities.why: New operator since Jul 2026 — worth a fresh look this week
activities.parking: Two floors of carpark above the hawker centre

activities.title: Sungei Buloh free guided walk — Saturday morning mangrove nature tour
activities.description: NParks runs a free guided tour of Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve every Saturday from 9.30am to 11.30am, led by experienced volunteer guides through the mangrove and freshwater wetland trails. Expect migratory birds, mudskippers, horseshoe crabs and monitor lizards. Maximum 15 participants and online registration is required; walks are cancelled if it rains.
activities.why: The only scheduled Saturday guided walk this week — free and family-friendly
activities.parking: On-site parking at the Visitor Centre; registration is via nparks.gov.sg and closes when the 15 slots fill

activities.title: Wings of Time — nightly fireworks show over the sea at Sentosa
activities.description: Singapore's only daily night show staged outdoors over the open sea at Siloso Beach, telling the story of Shahbaz the mythical bird with 3D water-screen projections, lasers, fountains, fire and a fireworks finale. Two shows nightly at 7.40pm and 8.40pm, each about 20 minutes. Standard tickets start from S$22.
activities.why: Singapore's only daily fireworks show — reliable nightly anchor for any evening plan
activities.parking: Beach Station Car Park; easiest by Sentosa Express to Beach Station

activities.title: Salomon's first SG outlet at IMM
activities.description: Salomon opened its first-ever Singapore outlet at IMM on 5 September 2026, marking the occasion with opening deals of up to 50% off selected products plus exclusive gifts with purchase. The store stocks the French outdoor brand's trail-running shoes, hiking footwear and everyday athleisure — worth a look if comfortable travel or walking shoes are on your list.
activities.why: First Salomon outlet in Singapore at IMM — trail and everyday footwear in the west.
activities.parking: IMM multi-storey carpark; Jurong East MRT is next door.

travel.geoQuery: IMM Building, 2 Jurong East Street 21, Singapore 609601

activities.title: Yamamoto's Hamburg — official opening 5 Oct at Lau Pa Sat
activities.description: Japanese hamburg chain Yamamoto's Hamburg (Yamahan) marks its official Singapore opening at Lau Pa Sat on 5 October 2026 (soft launch ran from 22 Sep). Signature Yamamoto Hamburg is S$19.90 (beef patty stuffed with Gorgonzola and mushroom cream, miso-dashi demi-glace); other hamburgs from S$15.90. From 5–7 Oct, first 300 redemptions/day with S$20 min spend get exclusive Yamahan stickers. Same founder as Hikiniku To Come.
activities.why: Official opening Mon 5 Oct — first Yamahan outside Japan; mains under $20 plus opening sticker drop.
activities.when: Official opening Mon 5 Oct; daily (hours via venue)
activities.parking: Limited around Lau Pa Sat; Raffles Place / Downtown MRT nearby.

travel.geoQuery: 18 Raffles Quay, Lau Pa Sat, Singapore 048582

activities.title: Dolpan Hwajoo — Busan hotstone dining pub in Tanjong Pagar
activities.description: Busan dining pub Dolpan Hwajoo has opened at 99 Tanjong Pagar Road with shareable hotstone classics — Dolpan Rose Daechang Dakbal (S$46++), Cheese Deunggalbi (S$48++), and ube / Shine Muscat makgeolli. Open till 1am Wed–Sat. Three minutes from Tanjong Pagar MRT.
activities.why: Brand-new Busan concept in the CBD with late hours — proper date-night Korean sharing plates.
activities.parking: Limited street / nearby carparks; Tanjong Pagar MRT ~3 min walk.

activities.title: Sansok — Culinary Class Wars chef brings hansang sets to Hougang
activities.description: Chef Min Yohan (Culinary Class Wars; Bibimdeli) opened Sansok at Hougang Mall #03-09A with charcoal-grilled hansang sets from S$12.90, free-flow banchan, and a $1 free-flow drinks + DIY bingsu add-on through 31 October. Hanok-inspired 64-seater in the heartlands.
activities.why: Netflix-famous Korean comfort food in Hougang — sets from $12.90 with opening drinks/bingsu deal.
activities.deal: Sets from $12.90; $1 drinks+bingsu promo till 31 Oct
activities.parking: Hougang Mall multi-storey; Hougang MRT nearby.

activities.title: Elijah Pies Joo Chiat flagship — pizza pies + pet-friendly patio
activities.description: Homegrown Elijah Pies opened its larger Joo Chiat flagship at 72 Joo Chiat Place on 12 September 2026 with exclusive pizza pies (from S$22), kaya toffee pie (S$9), and the Joo Chiat-only Elijah soufflé pie (S$18). Pet-friendly outdoor seating with water and treats; craft mocktails on the menu.
activities.why: New flagship with exclusive menu — and a patio you can bring a dog to.
activities.deal: Pies ~$9-24; opening gift bag with $40+drink spend while stocks last
activities.parking: Street parking along Joo Chiat Place; Eunos MRT.

activities.title: Fore Coffee — new Jurong Point outlet
activities.description: Indonesian coffee chain Fore Coffee has opened at Jurong Point — a fresh west-side specialty-coffee stop for iced classics and signature milky cups without needing a downtown detour.
activities.why: Still-new west Fore outlet at Jurong Point — easy near-home coffee stop.
activities.parking: Jurong Point JP1/JP2 carparks.

travel.geoQuery: 1 Jurong West Central 2, Jurong Point, Singapore 648886

activities.title: Daily Dim Sum opens at Jurong Point — $2 drink opening special
activities.description: Daily Dim Sum (天天点心) has opened at Jurong Point with steamed dim sum and an opening special: iced lemon tea or hot/cold HK milk tea for S$2 with selected dish purchases (U.P. up to S$4.90).
activities.why: Fresh west opening — classic steamer baskets without a trip downtown.
activities.when: Mall hours; $2 drink opening special while it lasts
activities.parking: Jurong Point JP1/JP2 carparks.

travel.geoQuery: 1 Jurong West Central 2, Jurong Point, Singapore 648886

activities.title: Aro — Johanne Siy's debut restaurant opens 25 Sep on Mohamed Sultan
activities.description: Chef Johanne Siy (formerly of Cloud Street) debuts Aro at 15 Mohamed Sultan Road on 25 September 2026 — a personal, ingredient-driven dining room. Expect a tight seasonal menu and the kind of soft opening buzz that books out fast.
activities.why: Opens today (25 Sep) — Johanne Siy's first solo restaurant; highlight Central dinner plan.
activities.parking: Limited street / nearby hotels; nearest MRT Fort Canning / Clarke Quay.

activities.title: BOMUL Samgyetang at Scotts Square — 1-for-1 ends today (2 Oct)
activities.description: Korean ginseng-chicken specialist BOMUL Samgyetang opens 25 September 2026 at Scotts Square #B1-08/09, 6 Scotts Road. Opening promo: 1-for-1 on the first 350 bowls each day from 25 Sep–2 Oct. Daily 11am–10pm.
activities.why: Opening 1-for-1 on the first 350 bowls/day ends Fri 2 Oct — last chance for the capped deal.
activities.when: Daily 11am–10pm; 1-for-1 first 350 bowls/day ends Fri 2 Oct
activities.parking: Scotts Square / Wheelock Place / Orchard carparks; Orchard MRT.

activities.title: Noci Bakehouse — new Orchard Gateway outlet
activities.description: Noci Bakehouse opens a new outlet at Orchard Gateway #01-09, 277 Orchard Road — pastries, soft loaves and café staples in the heart of Orchard. Daily 8:30am–8:30pm.
activities.why: Brand-new Orchard bakehouse stop — easy pre-movie or mid-mall pastry run.
activities.parking: Orchard Gateway / 313@Somerset carparks; Somerset MRT.

activities.title: Maison Yoshoku at Raffles City — floating dessert bar
activities.description: Maison Yoshoku opened around 23 September 2026 at Raffles City with modern yoshoku dining and Singapore's first floating dessert bar — still one of the freshest City Hall openings.
activities.why: Still-new Raffles City yoshoku room with Singapore's first floating dessert bar.
activities.parking: Raffles City carpark; City Hall MRT.

travel.geoQuery: 252 North Bridge Road, Raffles City, Singapore 179103

activities.title: TLM Food Expo at Singapore EXPO Hall 6A — final run 2–4 Oct
activities.description: TLM Food Expo returns for its final 2026 instalment at Singapore EXPO Hall 6A — 2–4 October, 11am–9pm, free entry. More than 120 local and international exhibitors with products from Malaysia, Thailand, China, Taiwan and more.
activities.why: Free-entry Expo food fair this Fri–Sun (2–4 Oct) — last TLM run of the year.
activities.parking: EXPO carparks; Expo MRT.

travel.geoQuery: 1 Expo Drive, Singapore EXPO Hall 6A, Singapore 486150

activities.title: Tian Tian Hainanese Chicken Rice — new Jewel Changi Airport outlet
activities.description: Tian Tian Hainanese Chicken Rice — the Maxwell Food Centre institution — has opened at Jewel Changi Airport, joining Eatbook's September 2026 new-restaurants roundup. Another reason to stitch Jewel into an East loop with Expo.
activities.why: Famous Maxwell chicken rice now at Jewel — easy East add-on with TLM Expo.
activities.parking: Jewel / Changi Airport carparks; Changi Airport MRT.

activities.title: Bari Bari Steak — new outlet at JEM
activities.description: Bari Bari Steak has opened a new outlet at JEM #01-16, 50 Jurong Gateway Road — a fresh west-side teppan steakhouse stop without needing a downtown detour.
activities.why: Still-new JEM steakhouse — easy west teppan without a city trip.
activities.parking: JEM / Westgate carparks; Jurong East MRT.

activities.heatNote: Beachside — go earlier for cooler terrace seating.
activities.title: Fico at Tanjong Beach Club — coastal Italian opens 28 Sep
activities.description: Fico opens its second restaurant by the sea at Tanjong Beach Club, 120 Tanjong Beach Walk, on 28 September 2026 — coastal Italian with a charcoal grill. Hours: Mon–Thu 10am–8pm, Fri 10am–9pm, Sat/Sun/PH 9am–9pm.
activities.why: Opens Mon 28 Sep — coastal Italian charcoal-grill dining at Tanjong Beach Club; South highlight for the week.
activities.when: Opens Mon 28 Sep; Mon–Thu 10–8, Fri 10–9, Sat/Sun/PH 9–9
activities.parking: Sentosa beach / Tanjong Beach access; Sentosa Express + walk/bus.

travel.geoQuery: 120 Tanjong Beach Walk, Tanjong Beach Club, Singapore 098942

activities.title: Unagi Yondaime Kikukawa — second SG outlet opens at Raffles City
activities.description: The Michelin-approved Nagoya unagi specialist opened its second Singapore restaurant on 1 October 2026 at #B1-75 Raffles City Shopping Centre (252 North Bridge Road), in partnership with Les Amis Group. Whole eels are filleted and grilled over binchotan; classic Kabayaki and Shirayaki sets are the signatures. Shaw Centre remains the first outlet.
activities.why: Opened Thu 1 Oct — 90-year-old unagi masters now at Raffles City / City Hall MRT.
activities.parking: Raffles City carpark; directly above City Hall MRT.

travel.geoQuery: 252 North Bridge Road, Raffles City #B1-75, Singapore 179103

activities.title: Creamie Sippies Bugis — SG's first DIY banana pudding bar
activities.description: Creamie Sippies opened its fourth outlet at Bugis Street (#02-115, 160A Rochor Road) around 28 September 2026. The headline is Singapore's first DIY banana pudding bar — bowls from S$4.50, or S$6.90 for two scoops + three toppings (Oreo, Lotus Biscoff, KitKat and more). Hand-whisked matcha drinks and a limited fall menu (Bueno Latte, Butter Popcorn Latte) run through 30 November.
activities.why: Brand-new Bugis outlet with Singapore's first DIY banana pudding bar — four minutes from Bugis MRT.
activities.parking: Bugis area carparks; Bugis MRT ~4 min walk.

activities.title: Food Opera at ION Orchard — 18 stalls, heritage + award names
activities.description: ION Orchard's basement food court reopened as Food Opera (B4) in late September 2026 — 20,000 sq ft, 600 seats, 18 brands. Highlights: 93-year-old Ming Chung White Lor Mee, Hillman Restaurant claypot and paper-wrapped chicken, MasterChef winner Derek Cheong's Berempah Bros, Michelin-recognised Ah Er Herbal Soup and Bib Gourmand MP Thai, plus Toast Box's first live-roasting outlet.
activities.why: Just-reopened Orchard food atrium — heritage hawkers and award stalls under one roof.
activities.parking: ION Orchard carpark; Orchard MRT.

travel.geoQuery: 2 Orchard Turn, ION Orchard B4-04, Singapore 238801

activities.title: Jomaru Korean Hot Pot — gamjatang chain opens in Tanjong Pagar
activities.description: Korean gamjatang specialist Jomaru (220+ outlets worldwide; roots to 1989) has opened at 75 Tanjong Pagar Road. One-person haejangguk from S$21.80; sharing gamjatang from S$56.80; hot pot combo S$108.80 feeds 3–4 with braised pork bone and a pancake or cold spicy rice cake. Open daily till 2am.
activities.why: Fresh Tanjong Pagar Korean hot-pot opening — proper gamjatang till 2am.
activities.parking: Limited street / nearby carparks; Tanjong Pagar MRT minutes away.

activities.title: Mummys Market Biggest Baby Fair — Singapore EXPO Hall 5, 2–4 Oct
activities.description: Mummys Market Biggest Baby Fair in Southeast Asia runs 2–4 October 2026 at Singapore EXPO Hall 5, 11am–9pm, free admission. 250,000+ baby and maternity products, seminars, workshops, and freebies (pregnancy goodie bags, diapers, samples) while stocks last — discounts up to 90% off.
activities.why: Free-entry Expo baby fair this Fri–Sun (2–4 Oct) — pair with TLM Food Expo next door.
activities.parking: EXPO carparks; Expo MRT.

travel.geoQuery: 1 Expo Drive, Singapore EXPO Hall 5, Singapore 486150

activities.title: Winter Time Expo Sales — Hall 6B through 4 Oct
activities.description: Winter Time's biggest winter-wear and luggage expo sale runs at Singapore EXPO Hall 6B 1–4 October 2026, daily 10:30am–9:30pm — parkas, jackets, thermal wear and luggage with expo-only deals (up to 80% off while stocks last).
activities.why: Last days Fri–Sun through Sun 4 Oct — winter wear + luggage at Expo Hall 6B.
activities.parking: EXPO carparks; Expo MRT.

travel.geoQuery: 1 Expo Drive, Singapore EXPO Hall 6B, Singapore 486150

activities.title: 1971 Porsche 917 KH at Jewel — free display through 5 Oct
activities.description: The 1971 Porsche 917 KH from the Porsche Museum (Spa 1,000 km record car) is on free public display at Porsche at Jewel, Jewel Changi Airport, through Monday 5 October 2026. After Jewel it moves to Raceborn Fest (9–11 Oct) at Guoco Midtown — catch it at Jewel this week before F1 crowds.
activities.why: Free museum race-car display at Jewel through Mon 5 Oct — last days this week.
activities.when: Daily through Mon 5 Oct (Porsche at Jewel hours)
activities.parking: Jewel / Changi Airport carparks; Changi Airport MRT.

travel.geoQuery: 78 Airport Boulevard, Porsche at Jewel, Singapore 819666

activities.title: VE/LA — Bangkok 24-hour cafe opens at Changi T1
activities.description: Bangkok specialty coffee and matcha chain VE/LA opened its first Singapore cafe at Changi Airport Terminal 1 (#01-K22, landside by Jewel) on 25 September 2026 — and it runs 24 hours. Singapore exclusive: Kaya Toast Latte (S$10) with pandan kaya, coconut cream, toast cubes and salted egg drizzle. No boarding pass needed.
activities.why: Brand-new 24-hour specialty cafe at Changi T1 — Kaya Toast Latte is the local exclusive.
activities.parking: Changi T1 / Jewel carparks; Changi Airport MRT.

activities.title: KOKO Kawane — farm-to-cup matcha atelier at The Star Vista
activities.description: KOKO Kawane opened 30 September 2026 at The Star Vista #01-02 (1 Vista Exchange Green) — a tie-up between GAIA Group's KOKO patisserie and Kawane Matcha, a Shizuoka tea farm run by the Ohashi family since the 1600s. Okumidori first-flush tencha is freshly ground to order; lattes from S$8.50, usucha from S$7, cakes S$10–14. Opening treat: free Matcha Clicker Mystery Box with S$25 spend while stocks last.
activities.why: Opened 30 Sep — west-side matcha milled to order from a 400-year-old Shizuoka farm.
activities.deal: Matcha drinks ~$7-14; free mystery box with $25 spend
activities.parking: The Star Vista carpark; Buona Vista MRT.

travel.geoQuery: 1 Vista Exchange Green, The Star Vista #01-02, Singapore 138617

activities.title: Curiosity Cove The Mischief Within — Mandai's first Halloween
activities.description: Mandai Curiosity Cove's first Halloween, The Mischief Within, runs 1 October–1 November 2026. Boo-tiful Day (daily 10am–5:30pm) is included with regular admission — pumpkin games and Quest Card badges. Sundown evenings (6:30–9:30pm) run this weekend Fri 2 & Sat 3 Oct (also later Oct weekends): trail challenges, bubble show and Best Dressed awards. Sundown from S$40 (Fri/Sun) or S$50 (Sat) for one adult + one child.
activities.why: Mandai's first Halloween — free daytime layer all week; Sundown nights Fri 2 & Sat 3 Oct.
activities.deal: Daytime incl. admission; Sundown from $40 adult+child
activities.parking: Mandai Wildlife Reserve carparks; Mandai Khatib Shuttle / public buses.
activities.heatNote: Evening outdoor/indoor mix — light jacket for kids after 8pm.

travel.geoQuery: 80 Mandai Lake Road, Curiosity Cove, Singapore 729979

activities.title: Raikan Ilmu@Heartlands closing edition — One Punggol 3–4 Oct
activities.description: Yayasan MENDAKI's Raikan Ilmu@Heartlands closing edition lands at One Punggol on 3–4 October 2026, 10am–6pm — the final stop of a five-month nationwide roadshow.
